page.overview:
Who is John Wilkes Booth?

Junius Brutus Booth † (father) Mary Ann Holmes † (mother) Junius Brutus Booth Jr. † (brother) Edwin Booth † (brother) Asia Booth Clarke † (sister) Edwina Booth Grossman † (niece)

John Wilkes Booth is one of the minor characters, debuting in Season 1's flashbacks.

He was an American actor, and he is known for assassinating the 16th U.S. president, Abraham Lincoln.

Little is known about John’s personality, but it was likely similar to that of his real-life counterpart.
